crossCuttingRequirements.ownerValueDirective: Middle/top full houses and near nuts checked to in PLO require value-bet-default evaluation; facing a big bet compare calling before escalating. Separate bottom full, stronger boats/quads, multi-board and tournament utility exceptions. No blanket hand-category profitability claim.
crossCuttingRequirements.memory: Prior public observations only; no private-card pooling or coordinated actions; exact domain and uncertainty retained.
crossCuttingRequirements.lightning: Require captured Lightning rules/version and public seat history; do not infer rules from speed alone.
crossCuttingRequirements.bbAnte: Preserve actual dead investment, ante payer, pot odds and stack geometry; no blanket aggression multiplier.
crossCuttingRequirements.bubble: Prize utility requires historical field/payout evidence; stage labels alone do not supply ICM.
crossCuttingRequirements.riverBluff: Measure eligible opportunities, proposal, acceptance and outcomes separately; compare size-specific fold/call/raise responses.
crossCuttingRequirements.activation: Use existing source-owned qualification and selection; this manifest is not accepted as an approval or runtime policy.
